A practical guide to building a fair price comparison—what to check, warning signs to notice, and a five-minute checklist before you buy.

content_html:
Before you buy, use these practical checks to compare the exact UK offer. The worked examples use assumed figures; confirm the current item, delivered price and seller terms before ordering.

Audit the checkout total before paying

Match the basket to the offer you researched

Recheck the model suffix, storage or capacity, condition and seller at checkout. A marketplace page can change the selected offer when a variant sells out. Confirm that the image and headline are describing the same bundle as the contents list. Do not let a substituted colour or size conceal a different specification.

Recalculate the delivered price

Include delivery to your postcode, estimated any additional checkout charges, mandatory membership, installation and essential accessories. Illustrative example: a £90 item with £12 delivery costs £102 before tax, while a £100 item with free delivery costs £100. That is arithmetic, not a current deal. If a coupon has a cap or applies only to part of the order, calculate the actual deduction.

Check what happens if the purchase is unsuitable

Find the current return window, return destination and who pays delivery. Keep voluntary returns and warranty repair as separate questions rather than assuming one policy answers both. For bulky goods, inspect pickup and repackaging requirements. Save the written policy and the final basket before payment.

Make the final choice without the discount badge

Ask whether you would still select this exact product at this total if the countdown disappeared. If it remains the least expensive complete option that meets your needs, the comparison is useful. If a cheaper offer depends on an accessory you have not priced or a return process you cannot use, finish those checks first.

Worked checkout: the apparent saving that disappears

Imagine two offers for the same vacuum and condition. Offer A is £120 with £15 delivery and no crevice tool. Offer B is £140 delivered with the tool included. If the correct tool costs £12 delivered, A becomes £147 before any applicable tax, so B is £7 less on those assumptions. If you already own the compatible tool, A could instead be the cheaper usable option. These example figures show why a bundle is worth only what you would otherwise need to buy. They are not product prices or a claim that one retailer is consistently cheaper. Recalculate with the actual destination, contents and accessories.

Check the discount conditions line by line

Confirm that the code applies to the selected seller and variant, that any minimum spend is met and that the deduction appears in the final total. Check whether a maximum discount limits the saving and whether delivery is excluded. If a membership is necessary, decide whether you already have it or would pay for it solely for this order. Keep cashback or a future voucher separate from the amount payable now; it may have its own conditions and timing. Do not count the same saving twice when a product page already displays a reduced price. The basket total is the number to compare.

Keep a record that will help if something differs

Save the exact product page, selected variant, seller name, condition description and included equipment, plus the order confirmation and current return policy. Make sure the saved material identifies the purchase rather than only a generic category page. If the delivery date matters, record what the seller actually promised and whether it was an estimate. Use the retailer or marketplace's official communication route for questions. Before paying, review whether any unresolved detail affects your ability to use or return the item. A small saving does not settle a missing-model or missing-accessory question. Finish those checks while you can still choose another offer.

Put the checks into practice

Try a final basket audit: read each line aloud and mark it required, optional or unexplained. Remove optional additions you did not intend to buy and investigate unexplained charges. Confirm the selected delivery service and destination, then compare the resulting total with your saved alternative. If an offer has changed, update your comparison instead of relying on yesterday's screenshot. Finish by saving the actual order details; a promotional page by itself may not record the seller, condition or bundle you selected.
